hiring.positions_note: None open today. The live UCM employer page shows the heading “Trabajos en U. Catolica del Maule - Trabaja con nosotros” but no job cards, including no Medicine or Internal Medicine academic post.
hiring.requires_chilean_title_note: No open academic advert was available, so no vacancy-specific rule on nationality, foreign degrees or revalidación could be read. Separately, UCM's medical-specialty regulation states: “Poseer el Título Profesional de Médico Cirujano obtenido en Chile y/o convalidado si corresponde.” This is relevant to clinical postgraduate training, not evidence of an academic-hiring rule.

international.notes: The official page identifies Andrew Philominraj as Director de Relaciones Internacionales (andrew@ucm.cl). UCM reports international mobility and visiting/international activity, including international interns in Faculty of Medicine laboratories. I found no official evidence that any Medicine course is taught in English.

profile_paragraphs: UCM’s Facultad de Medicina is based at Campus San Miguel, Avenida San Miguel 3605, Talca. Its official faculty page identifies Dr. Iván Castillo Montecino as dean.
The Medicine degree’s quality-assurance process dates from 2004. UCM states that the degree underwent accreditation processes in 2009, 2011 and 2015.
The Hospital Regional de Talca is UCM’s principal teaching hospital and a high-complexity regional referral centre. It is the key clinical setting for the faculty’s residency training.

For a rheumatologist, the affiliated hospital documents a rheumatology outpatient-care process. However, UCM’s published medical-specialty catalogue does not list a Rheumatology specialty or subspecialty programme.

No official evidence was found of Medicine courses taught in English.

No UCM rheumatology specialty/beca programme was found in the published medical-specialty catalogue.
